faqs.q: Does this integrate with our accounting software?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow exports vendor bills and payments to Tally Prime as importable voucher XML and pushes data to Zoho Books, Google Sheets, and Google Drive through encrypted OAuth integrations.

faqs.q: Can field teams request materials from mobile devices?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Field superintendents can submit material requisitions directly from the SiteFlow mobile app, which then routes through your customizable approval workflows.

faqs.q: How customizable are the approval workflows?
faqs.a: Highly customizable. You can set routing rules based on project, dollar amount thresholds, cost codes, or specific material categories so the right people approve every purchase.
